explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 84 named tracks/releases across Boomkat current September 2026 releases and preorders, Resident Advisor current reviews, Juno's current techno window, Bandcamp exact release pages, and targeted overlooked-catalogue cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. No threat- or panic-coded proposition was advanced.
Completed Runs 228, 231, 232, 233 and 235 selected identities and their exact boundaries were compared before ranking. The three highest-ranked boundaries do not repeat those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Existing retained Sa Pa — World Saving Banger and previously retained Buttechno identities were excluded.
Sa Pa — Rhythm From Ambient moved from a prior release watch to a current exact four-track release on 2026-09-14; this is new outward evidence, not a triggered canonical repair.
The Sa Pa and Buttechno groups have differentiated exact-track prose. Multiple same-release leads are ranked independently for resolver identity; no artist, texture or novelty quota is applied.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
